newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Russian PM arrives for Lisbon security summit.
newsitem.headline: Russian PM arrives for Lisbon security summit.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin arrived in Lisbon on Sunday to attend a pan-European security summit at which he is expected to repeat Moscow's opposition to NATO's eastward expansion.
Before leaving Moscow, Chernomyrdin told reporters that Russia had no intention of easing its tough position against the alliance's plans to admit former Soviet satellite states as members.
"We are categorically against the expansion of NATO to the east," Interfax news agency quoted him as saying. "Russia has its position and will stand by it at the OSCE meeting."
Chernomyrdin is standing in at the summit for President Boris Yeltsin, who is still convalescing after major heart surgery a month ago.
